name: click_text
description:
Finds text on the screen using OCR and clicks its center coordinate.
Eliminates manual coordinate guessing for text buttons, labels, and links (e.g. 'Document', 'Leo', 'Send', 'OK', 'Cancel').

clicks.description: 1 for single click, 2 for double click.

match_index.description: If multiple occurrences of text exist, which match to click (0 for first/topmost).
